claims.statement: DocuSign Standard and Business Pro include up to 100 envelopes per user per year; Business Pro adds bulk send, payment collection, signer attachments, and PowerForms; HIPAA BAA, FedRAMP, and 21 CFR Part 11 are contact-sales items.
Acrobat Standard for teams costs US$16.99 per license per month and Acrobat Pro US$23.99; Adobe says Standard and Pro e-signatures do not offer the same compliance level as Acrobat Sign Solutions.

Under 15 U.S.C. 7001(a)(1), a signature or contract may not be denied legal effect solely because it is in electronic form; 7001(c) requires affirmative consumer consent for electronic records that replace required writings.
